node.text: "Lovely stay! The cabin was comfortable, clean, and peaceful. Great hospitality from the staff. Everything was well maintained, and the staff made sure we had everything we needed. It’s the perfect getaway spot — I’ll definitely return. Highly recommended!"

Set in Canggu, 8.8 km from Ubung Bus Station, Andewi Cabin offers accommodation with a garden, free private parking and a terrace. The property is located 12 km from Bali Museum, 12 km from Petitenget Temple and 13 km from Udayana University. The accommodation provides room service and free WiFi throughout the property.
Children of any age are welcome.
Children 18 years and above will be charged as adults at this property.
